newsitem.title: USA: GenRad buys techonology testing company.
newsitem.headline: GenRad buys techonology testing company.

text.p: GenRad Inc said Monday that it has acquired Testware Inc, a privately-held company in Florida and Massachusettes, for an undisclosed sum of cash and GenRad common stock.
Testware provides custom test programming for high-technology makers, for such tasks as identifying assembly errors on printed circuit boards.
GenRad said Testware will be part of its new Integrated Customer Services division.
The division will also include Test Technology Associates, which GenRad acquired in January, and Production Solutions International, GenRad said.
The new division "will help accommodate GenRad's goal of double-digit revenue and earnings growth," GenRad Vice President Sarah Lucas said in a release.
It will have offices in Texas, California, Florida, Massachusetts and in the United Kingdom, France and Germany, GenRad said.
GenRad provides software, systems and services to electronic manufacturers.
